Converted map — King James area — CONVERTED PREVIEW 1

This is the CONVERTED map — Joshua's approval gate. The streets, houses and ground on this page all come from the converted zone data (the full OSM rebuild turned into game zone data), not from the old hand-fixed preview data, and nothing here has replaced the live game — this page is only for the walk test. The dark ribbon in front of you is King James Drive Southwest, which lives in the converted southfulton zone (checked: of all seven converted zones, only southfulton's area touches this circle). The circle is centred on King James's own midpoint in zone coordinates (3172.08, 11093.28); its radius is the same one mile as the earlier previews — 1,609.34 m in rebuild metres, which the conversion turns into 1627.6 zone units east–west and 1549.1 zone units north–south (the zone frame stretches the two directions slightly differently, so a round mile on the real ground is an oval here). Inside it: 493 converted road records (497 pieces after cutting at the circle's edge, 5559 road points). Every street is built in strips — narrow streets get 3 strips across, medium 4, the widest 5 — and every strip edge is set to exactly 0.01 over the ground, so the whole road surface follows the ground across its width as well as along it; there is no flat ribbon and no space under the road. The ground itself is the game's ground over the converted DEM terrain (the real elevation survey, compressed to the game's height scale, with no terrain lifts). Houses: 2387 converted buildings drawn exactly as shipped — the ones Stage 1 had to move off streets (39 inside this circle) are already at their moved positions, and 3 that could not be cleared were flagged and left exactly in place (see the buildings line below). One honest note: the far south edge of the circle runs past the edge of the game's stage (z = 12,000) — 1224 of the road points inside the circle are out there; the game's ground holds its edge height past that line (its terrain mesh ends there), and the converted roads were baked against exactly that ground, so this page uses the same edge-held ground there. A red car is parked on King James next to the character — walk up to it and press E or the 🚗 Get in button to drive. Driving uses big press-and-hold buttons — ◀ ▶ steer (bottom left) and GAS / BRAKE pedals (bottom right) — or the keys (W/S or ↑/↓ = gas & brake/reverse, A/D or ←/→ = steer). Press E again to get out. While you drive, the view sits on the roof of the car, facing forward, with only a sliver of hood at the bottom; tap the 📷 button to move the camera (Forward / Back / Left / Right / Up / Down, 0.1 per tap) and tilt it (1° steps), then Save camera to keep the setup on this device. Orbiting is a button: by default a drag pans and two fingers zoom; tap the 🔄 Orbit button (top right) and drags orbit instead. The light-blue road is King James seen through the ground (toggle: X-ray street). Walk with the joystick (bottom left) or keys; drive with the buttons or keys — the readout should say on the surface everywhere.
